name: Baseline Measurement

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## Baseline Measurement

The closing state of part 1 (commit 48e5fc6) is the baseline: results/2026-10-16-macos-loop, see benchmark/LOOP-2026-10-16.md.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Same as part 1: ab.sh (stashed HEAD, then the change, 3 reps), alternating one binary with an environment switch for small effects, `sample` profiles for where the work is.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

Baseline metrics are captured and stored so later experiments compare against a known starting point.
reportMarkdown:
## Baseline Measurement Finished

Part 1 ended at 19 experiments (8 kept of 11 hypotheses plus an investigation, a revert and the baseline). Open: scroll-div-cards 3.4 ms draw (owner view renders and lays out its content on every scroll frame), dashboard-clock 2.4 ms draw (per-element claim, copy and replay of 2,600 retained elements), scroll footprint 1.30-1.46x off.

Attempt Count: 1.
decisionMarkdown:
### Decision

Baseline recorded; candidates: owner-view skip on scroll-only frames, cheaper splice layout verification, retained-node claim by range.
